source_sample: US - Bioresco Univ of Maryland Current/Future Price.xlsx
description: US Bioresco (University of Maryland) distributor file (xlsx, 5 columns): catalog number, description, unit size, List Price and discounted Bioresco Price as 2dp text USD for the price period. Description uses ariba_name()/clean_ariba_text().

columns.expression: clean_ariba_text(ariba_name(row), False, False) + ' ' + lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_marketing_name_details.csv', 'qty_mkt_txt_abbrev_units', row['size'] + ' ' + row['size_unit'].replace(chr(181), 'u'))
